environmentVariables.name: AGENT_PRIVATE_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Price-bait guard for call_service: refuse to pay if a paid gateway call's total x402 charge exceeds this many USD. Optional (default: no ceiling); overridable per call via the maxPriceUsd argument.
environmentVariables.name: FIATDOCK_MAX_PRICE_USD
